notes: Observation review: versions now identify their website and Google account. Previously the Observation version table showed only id/status/observed-days/submitted-at, and the record never stored which Google identity the observation was submitted under (only the GA4 property id inside the config, which was stripped from the list payload). (1) On submit, the route now snapshots the resolving GA4 binding and its connection identity onto the version (bindingId, connectionId, resourceIdentifier, credentialVersion, authMethod, connectionLabel, and the account identity: the service-account email or the OAuth Google subject). It is a submit-time truth, not the live binding, so it does not change if the binding later changes; older versions have no snapshot and are shown as 未记录 rather than back-filling the current binding. (2) The review table gains 网站 / GA4 资源 / 账户 columns (site host resolved from the always-present siteId; property id and account from the snapshot) and the version detail gains 测量 ID / Google 账户 / 认证方式 / GA4 绑定. No SQL migration and no schema change: the added field is optional and read-tolerant, so a rollback to v0.2.16 keeps running and simply ignores it.
